selection: Fixed ten-name research basket per sector, chosen before this run; not ranked on backtest returns. This is not an index membership reconstruction or an investment recommendation.
missing_data_policy: Fail complete-universe headline on any missing security; publish coverage failure, never silently drop it.
limitations: Current survivors selected today do not supply delisted securities or historical index constituents.
Historical results are exploratory; only separately timestamped future observations are prospective.
Equal starting capital per name is a technical research sleeve, not live PM sizing.
